policy: Current official CUT! Energy pricing is safely attachable to confirmed CUT-owned EVSE for the registered-app channel: 0.45 EUR/kWh AC and 0.56 EUR/kWh DC, with the published time-window blocking rules. This seed attaches the current DC app tariff to four exact DE*CUT EVSE at Joy'n-Us Dülmen. A historical GoingElectric ad-hoc price of 0.49 EUR/kWh on the same station was last updated 2024-09-17 and is deliberately NOT imported as a current 2026 ad-hoc tariff. CUT's official page confirms ad-hoc/card charging and exposes a receipt portal at cut-energy.mycharge.cc, but the public receipt portal could not be fetched in this run; no ad-hoc fallback is therefore inferred.
